SEVERITY: major
WHERE: scripts/ci-watch.sh:44,92,110 (runs_tsv and gh run view calls)
ISSUE: gh CLI failures are silently swallowed with `2>/dev/null`, so a transient network/auth/rate-limit error mid-watch makes the watcher proceed with empty/stale data and print misleading messages or wrong exit codes instead of surfacing the error — a CI watcher that can't distinguish "all green" from "gh broke" defeats its purpose.
FIX: Stop suppressing gh stderr (or capture and report it), and exit non-zero with a clear message whenever `gh run list`/`gh run view` fails.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/ci-watch.sh:124 (after `--rerun-failed` loop)
ISSUE: `--rerun-failed` triggers `gh run rerun --failed` but immediately reports "✓ ci-watch: all green" (exit 0) without waiting for the rerun jobs to finish, giving false confidence.
FIX: Re-poll after rerun until the rerun jobs complete, or state that the rerun was triggered and only exit 0 once confirmed green.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/ci-watch.sh:103
ISSUE: The log digest matches step names against `$2` of `gh run view --log` output, which is plain text not TSV, so targeted step-log extraction never matches and falls through to a blunt tail of the whole log.
FIX: Pull failed steps/log from the already-fetched `gh run view --json jobs` payload instead of grepping raw log text.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/ci-watch.sh:30
ISSUE: `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` silently changes to HOME when not inside a git repo (empty cd target), then runs gh against the wrong directory.
FIX: Guard it: `root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 2; cd "$root"`.

SEVERITY: minor
WHERE: scripts/ci-watch.sh (new file, no tests)
ISSUE: New polling/failure/rerun behavior has no test coverage.
FIX: Add shell tests (e.g., bats/shunit) mocking gh to cover success, failure digest, cancelled, timeout, and rerun paths.

VERDICT: FIX
